payload.text: Decision 23's unread gap, read at 07:35Z on 2026-09-21 by dc: doctor rc=0 with 0 failed in all 14 swept estates, and every estate carries the same runtime and bin/devbin digest. Fingerprints: 12 clean. Lamplight's delta is its own live lanes, placed by TZ=UTC timing outside the doctor window. Gtools and Intent each showed a write under .git, which is a core finding. vc reproduced it independently at 07:36Z: git_head_identity (lib/helpers) runs plain git status, which rewrites .git/index when its stat info is stale; with --no-optional-locks it writes nothing. So doctor and --version write to the repository and can fail a peer's concurrent commit. dc is to file an issue and build the fix for 0.1.3, red first on a stale-stat fixture, with vc reviewing. This is a doctor read, not a suite run: no estate's own gates have run against 0.1.2.
